metadata.case_name: LAI YUN TAI v. CHAN KIN HONG AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: Casual dishwashing or other domestic work

injuries.description: Hospitalised for a total of 18 days suffering from post traumatic amnesia as a result of severe concusssion.
source: Hospitalised for a total of 18 days suffering from post traumatic amnesia as a result of severe concusssion.
injuries.icd_description: Concussion with incomplete loss of consciousness with amnesia

injuries.description: Anosmia, or loss of her sense of smell, which appears to he permanent.
source: Anosmia, or loss of her sense of smell, which appears to he permanent.

injuries.description: Damaged teeth, including a badly chipped upper lateral incisor tooth, which cause problems when chewing tough food.
source: Damaged teeth, including a badly chipped upper lateral incisor tooth, which cause problems when chewing tough food.

injuries.description: A 3 cm laceration of the lower lip which has left a noticeable scar.
source: A 3 cm laceration of the lower lip which has left a noticeable scar.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: Fractured pelvis involved both pubic bones.
source: Fractured pelvis involved both pubic bones.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of pubis without disruption of pelvic ring

manifestations.description: Lost consciousness from injuries received in this accident and only recovered full consciousness a couple of weeks later in Hospital.
She still suffers from severe headaches once or twice a month which last for about a day or so at a time and that she consults a doctor for medication in the form of pills to control the headaches.
She has no sense of smell since the accident.
Some difficulty in breathing through her nasal passages when she is in a polluted environment.
She suffers pain from her teeth in eating tough food.
Noticeable scar on lower lip from a 3 cm laceration.
Decrease in pelvic inlet; advised to seek medical advice in any future pregnancy because of possible difficulty with labour which could result in a Caessarean section.

treatments_future: Dental treatment recommended by Robert C. M. Bong costing $28,500

losses.description: Recurring headaches from post-concussional symptoms (post traumatic amnesia/severe concussion).
Anosmia / loss of sense of smell which appears to be permanent.
Noticeable scar on lower lip from a 3 cm laceration.

losses.category: Loss of ability to enjoy food and drink
losses.description: Pain when chewing tough food due to damaged teeth including a badly chipped upper lateral incisor tooth.

losses.category: Loss of ability to give natural childbirth
losses.description: Decrease in pelvic inlet with possible difficulty with labour which could result in a Caessarean section.
Unable to resume former employment as a construction site labourer due to lack of strength in lifting heavy objects; prospects restricted to casual dishwashing or other domestic work.
